polymath: Already delivered, and by the shape every other muse uses: classes.bard.subclass.options["polymath"] carries grantedFeats ["versatile-performance"] AND grantedSpells ["phantasmal-minion"] — the muse spell is a repertoire spell there, exactly as enigma->sure-strike and maestro->soothe. selfish-shield: A reaction resolved at the table, and the registry key can never fire: the champion owns the cause `desecration` (which is what grants this), never the id `selfish-shield`, so nothing would ever look it up.

shadows-in-the-moonlight: The tactic body is ally-facing; the Special clause substitutes Warfare Lore, a Lore the app has no rank lane for (see this batch's own warfare-expertise verdict), and tactic ids never enter characterSituationalIds (explain.ts:189) so the star could never appear anyway.

sloth: Reclined Apport is already granted by the runelord `sin` effectChoice (grant.focusSpells:['reclined-apport']). The remaining sin-spell list is a no-op: every listed spell is already arcane, spellListAdditions is declared inside `interface Feat` (types.ts:801) so it is not a legal ClassFeature field, build.ts reads it only from content.feats, and the record is never owned. The judge's own `wrath` verdict calls granting this list an over-grant.

spasm-of-the-berserker: A 1-action transcendence resolved at the table; the proposed mode carries zero modifiers and its feats gate names `spasm-of-the-berserker`, an id nothing owns (it is a transcendence action, not an owned ikon), so the mode is invisible — the exact ungated-mode trap.

tempest-sun-mages: The fix is a no-op three ways: every one of the eleven spells is already in the arcane tradition so a wizard's pool already contains them; spellListAdditions is declared inside `interface Feat` and is not a legal ClassFeature field; and build.ts reads it only from content.feats. The record is also never owned (magaambyanBranch is a flag choice, not a classChoices pick).

uzunjati: The fix delivers nothing: all nine spells (including Kgalaserke's Axes and Ibex's Harvest) are already tagged arcane in core.spells, so a wizard's pool already holds them; spellListAdditions is a Feat-only field build.ts reads only from content.feats; and the record is never owned — magaambyanBranch is a `choice.flag` on the dedication feat, which never adds `uzunjati` to classChoices.

wrath: Vengeful Glare is ALREADY delivered: the runelord class-archetype record carries effectChoices id 'sin' whose wrath option is {grant:{focusSpells:['vengeful-glare']}}. The bare `sin` list on school-of-thassilonian-rune-magic is the descriptive twin.

engineWork.name: Advanced Deed
engineWork.reason: Auto-granted at gunslinger 9 and completely inert: the way's advanced deed is never handed over. The way subclass options carry only grants.skills, and the deed records (finish-the-job, vital-shot, spinning-crush, ...) live in classFeatures, which grantsFeats cannot reach (it resolves against the feats collection).

engineWork.name: Blessed Shield
engineWork.reason: A champion's shield should carry the reinforcing rune for their level (minor at 1st up to supreme at 19th), or +1 Hardness if it already has it. The app computes shield Hardness/HP/BT from an ETCHED reinforcing rune only (derive.ts reads held.inv.runes.reinforcing), and no field lets a class feature grant a level-scaling rune or a flat Hardness bump to the wielded shield.

engineWork.name: Bloodrager

The Blood Rage persistent-bleed rider (half your Rage damage) also has no lane: strikeDamage cannot be limited to the rage state.

engineWork.name: Custodian of Groves and Gardens

engineWork.name: Deific Weapon
engineWork.reason: Steps the damage die of the deity's favored weapon up one size when it is a simple weapon or a d4 unarmed attack, grants access if uncommon, and treats an advanced favored weapon as martial. derive.ts implements exactly this die step, but only for the FEAT Deadly Simplicity (hasDeadlySimplicity checks c.feats for 'deadly-simplicity'); a champion holds Deific Weapon as a class feature, so none of the three benefits apply. No record field can express a deity-dependent die step or a proficiency-category downgrade.

engineWork.name: Deity (Cleric)
engineWork.reason: The favored-weapon training IS delivered (build.ts writes proficiencies.weaponOverrides from deity.favoredWeapons, doctrine-scaled) and sanctification comes through the deity's own effectChoices, but the deity's granted SKILL is not: deities carry a 'skill' field (e.g. sarenrae.skill = medicine) and the only reader in src is derive.ts:270, for the Sanguine Pendant item bonus. Nothing trains it. The value is deity-dependent, so trainedSkill on this record cannot express it.

engineWork.name: Compact Skeleton

engineWork.name: Giant Instinct
engineWork.reason: The instinct's rage damage IS delivered (derive.ts RAGE_DAMAGE['giant-instinct'] tiers 6/10/18 with the larger-weapon note), but Raging Resistance (9th) is not — nothing grants resistance 3 + Con to bludgeoning and a chosen energy type while raging, and the sibling dragon-instinct record openly admits it ('Raging Resistance (9th) isn't applied'). The bludgeoning half fits the whileActive 'rage' lane; the cold/electricity/fire PICK does not, because EffectGrant (types.ts) has no whileActive member, so an effectChoices option could only grant the energy resistance unconditionally, which would over-grant it outside rage.

engineWork.name: Ligneous Instinct
engineWork.reason: Wooden Rage's damage IS delivered (RAGE_DAMAGE in derive.ts has 'ligneous-instinct': tiers [6,10,18]), but three printed pieces reach nothing and no legal field can express them: the −10-foot Speed while using wooden rage (speedPenalty is unconditional, and whileActive carries no speeds penalty), Raging Resistance's piercing/slashing resistance 3 + Con (whileActive rage resistances exist but have no minLevel, so attaching them would over-grant from level 1 instead of 9), and the fire weakness (whileActive has no weaknesses field).

engineWork.name: Lust
engineWork.reason: A wizard curriculum (Runelord sin) that exists ONLY as this classFeature — there is no matching wizard subclass option in core.json, so neither the initial school spell Heart's Hook nor the sin spell list reaches the character. Anathema is roleplay.

engineWork.name: Master Overdrive
engineWork.reason: Neither half arrives. "You become a master in Crafting": skill RANK raises have no record field (trainedSkill only grants trained) — the siblings live in featGrantsAuto.ts as 'expert-overdrive' {crafting: expert} and 'legendary-overdrive' {crafting: legendary}, but there is no 'master-overdrive' entry, and FEAT_GRANTS is applied only to taken FEATS (build.ts ~2384), never to class features. The +2 Overdrive damage also lands nowhere: the predefined 'cat-overdrive' mode ships modifiers: [] with a note only.

engineWork.name: Master Tactician
engineWork.reason: Class DC to master IS delivered (advancement.ts commander level 15, source 'master-tactician') and folio size comes from commanderFolioMax(level), but the prepared-tactics increase never happens — build.ts computes preparedMax = 3 + preparedTacticsBonus summed over content.feats only, so this feature (and Expert Tactician's raise to four) contribute nothing. The "legendary proficiency in Warfare Lore" raise also has no lane: no record field expresses a skill rank above trained, and the FEAT_GRANTS skills table is keyed to taken feats.

engineWork.name: Masterful Hunter (Precision)
engineWork.reason: Extra precision damage on the SECOND (and, at 19th, third) hit against your hunted prey in a round. strikeDamage is unconditional per Strike and situational carries no per-round hit counter, so there is no lane for "the Nth time in a round you hit" — the base Precision edge is equally unmodelled.

engineWork.name: Medium Armor Expertise (Inventor)
engineWork.reason: The proficiency half is ALREADY delivered (advancement.ts inventor level 11 lists unarmored/light/medium expert with source 'medium-armor-expertise-inventor'), but the second sentence — access to the critical specialization effect with a medium or heavy armor innovation — has no lane: critSpec is weapons-only (it is valid only alongside critSpecWeapons), and nothing expresses armour-group specialization effects.

engineWork.name: Modular Head
engineWork.reason: The innovation gains the modular trait (B/P/S) plus an on-demand nonlethal toggle, and the Strike never sees it. weaponTraits is the right family but its match filter only accepts melee/groups/anyTrait/items — there is no way to say "your weapon innovation", which is a player-chosen weapon resolved by inventorModificationOptions. The modification PICK is offered; its effect is not.

engineWork.name: Pride
engineWork.reason: A wizard sin/school record: the initial school spell (Crescent Scepter) is a focus spell that is never granted, and the sin spell list is never added to what you can prepare. All ids verified in core.json; the 2nd-rank entry has a second spell missing from the source text, so only the printed ones are listed. Anathema is roleplay.

engineWork.name: Raging Resistance
engineWork.reason: Resistance 3 + Con modifier to instinct-typed damage while raging reaches nothing: no classFeature carries whileActive, and none of the ten *-instinct features (animal-instinct, dragon-instinct, …) carries a resistance either. The lane exists — whileActive [{state:"rage",resistances:[…]}] with a "3+@actor.con.mod" formula (derive.ts substitutes @actor.<abil>.mod) — but it must be written on each INSTINCT feature, because this record cannot name the damage types; raging-resistance itself has nothing to carry.

engineWork.name: Razor Prongs
engineWork.reason: A selectable weapon-innovation modification (build.ts inventorModificationOptions offers it) whose whole content is "your innovation gains the tearing, trip, and versatile S traits" — and nothing adds them. weaponTraits cannot express it: derive.ts reads weaponTraits only from db.feats, and the innovation is never bound to an inventory item (InventorBuild.modifications is resolved "for display" only). Needs an innovation→item link plus weaponTraits on class features.

engineWork.name: Reveler in Lost Glee
engineWork.reason: The apparition spells and the Trickster's Mirrors vessel spell ARE delivered (classes.animist.extraChoices["apparition"] option carries grantedSpells + focusSpells), but the Apparition Skills — trained in Circus Lore and Fortune-Telling Lore while attuned, which the animist class text confirms you "forget" when the apparition is dispersed — reach nothing. No lane fits: trainedLore/trainedSkill exist only on Background, and the option-level `grants.skills` (used by witch patrons and exemplar epithets) is typed to SkillId, so it cannot carry two Lore subjects. Fix belongs on classes.animist.extraChoices apparition option once grants.skills accepts "lore:<Name>".

engineWork.name: Rope Shot
engineWork.reason: A selectable ranged weapon-innovation modification whose content is "your weapon innovation gains the climbing and ranged trip traits, and tethered if thrown" — nothing adds them. Same blocker as razor-prongs: derive.ts reads weaponTraits only from db.feats, and the innovation is never bound to an inventory weapon, so no legal field can target it.

engineWork.name: Rune Capacity
engineWork.reason: A selectable innovation modification granting one property rune slot beyond the item's normal limit (max four with +3 potency). No field expresses a rune-capacity change — there is no lane for the etching/rune-slot cap at all, and the innovation is not linked to an inventory item.

engineWork.name: Runelord's Calling
engineWork.reason: Identify Magic, Learn a Spell and casting a ritual are all player checks; the skill varies by tradition and by ritual, so the spend entry targets 'all' with the actions named. The regain clause names the four magic skills explicitly, so it is narrowed to those. Unmodelled.

engineWork.name: Saga's Calling
engineWork.reason: A Performance check or Gather Information (Diplomacy), at mythic proficiency for a Mythic Point. Unmodelled. The regain clause is Gather Information only, so it is narrowed to Diplomacy.

engineWork.name: Sage's Calling
engineWork.reason: Recall Knowledge with any skill, at mythic proficiency for a Mythic Point. Unmodelled. Unrestricted by skill, so 'all' is exact rather than a fallback.

engineWork.name: Skin Hard as Horn
engineWork.reason: The immanence grants resistance equal to half your level to a damage type you attune during daily preparations (not against critical hits). The player never picks the type and never gets the resistance.

engineWork.name: Speaker in Sibilance
engineWork.reason: Spells and vessel spell ARE delivered by the animist apparition option (grantedSpells + focusSpells:['crown-of-prophets']); its Apparition Skills — Fortune-Telling Lore and Mountain Lore while attuned — are delivered nowhere (no lore grant exists on any apparition option in core.json).

engineWork.name: Spell Blending
engineWork.reason: A wizard thesis that restructures the spell slot table at daily preparations — trade two slots of one rank for a bonus slot up to 2 ranks higher, or a slot for two extra cantrips. The player's slot line never changes.

engineWork.name: Spirit Instinct
engineWork.reason: Spirit Rage's damage IS delivered (RAGE_DAMAGE in derive.ts: 'spirit-instinct' tiers [3,7,13], type 'spirit'), but Raging Resistance at 9th — resistance to void damage and to damage dealt by undead creatures' attacks and abilities while raging — reaches nothing; no instinct carries a whileActive resistance anywhere in core.json.

engineWork.name: Stalker in Darkened Boughs
engineWork.reason: Spells and vessel spell ARE delivered by the animist apparition option (grantedSpells + focusSpells:['darkened-forest-form']); the Apparition Skills Forest Lore and Hunting Lore are delivered nowhere — and other feats explicitly test 'your attuned apparition grants Hunting Lore … as one of its apparition skills', so the training is load-bearing.

engineWork.name: Steward of Stone and Fire
engineWork.reason: Spells and vessel spell ARE delivered by the animist apparition option (grantedSpells + focusSpells:['earths-bile']); the Apparition Skills Mountain Lore and Volcano Lore are delivered nowhere.

engineWork.name: Tangle Line
engineWork.reason: An inventor weapon modification whose whole content is 'your innovation gains the parry, ranged trip and tethered traits' — real traits on the weapon the character actually wields, delivered nowhere.

engineWork.name: Thaumaturgic Mastery
engineWork.reason: The class DC master rank IS delivered (advancement.ts, thaumaturge level 17, source 'thaumaturgic-mastery'), but the additional skill increase restricted to Arcana/Nature/Occultism/Religion is never offered.

engineWork.name: Warfare Expertise
engineWork.reason: Auto-granted at Commander 3: expert proficiency in Warfare Lore, plus using Warfare Lore for initiative. There is no lane that raises a Lore skill's rank — AdvancementTrack (types.ts:77) has no skill/lore track, and the only record-level lore fields (trainedLore, loreChoices) grant trained only, so the expert bump cannot be expressed.

engineWork.name: Wildsong
engineWork.reason: Auto-granted at Druid 1: every druid knows the Wildsong in addition to their ancestry languages, and nothing adds it — classes.druid has no language grant, so the sheet's language list is short by one. `wildsong` is a real core.languages id.

fix.note: trainedLore holds a single subject and SubclassOption.grants.skills is SkillId[] (no 'lore:<Subject>'); an apparition grants TWO Lore skills. Needs a list-valued lore grant (or grants.skills accepting lore: keys, which EffectGrant.skills already does).

BuildState.skillIncreases is Record<level, ProficiencyKey>: exactly one increase per level, so a second increase at level 9 (restricted to four skills) cannot be represented or offered in the builder.
